adaptation: C++ host for nicxlive native packets and nijiexpose SDL3/ImGui. Hashes above identify the original nijimi shaders; part.frag, part_stage1.frag and part_stage2.frag additionally multiply RGB by part opacity for premultiplied blending. Host fixes add composite stencil attachments, threshold-aware mask writes, empty texture placeholders and the application's ambient-light operation.
status: Windows model and ImGui rendering, resize, model switch/removal and Vulkan validation tested; complete OpenGL feature parity is not claimed
